'answers': the phrases players type for each new meaning (matched as in answers.json: the longest phrase found wins). 'lines': what a Drifter says back, by voice. {player} is what it calls them, {name} itself; some kinds fill more: {item} {count} {what} (its things), {way} {dist} (directions), {who} (someone), {last} (its last line), {insult}, {doing}, and what it did lately ({ore} {built} {mob} {close_call} {traded_with} {news_who} {news_what}). Started by tools/chat_more/convo_seed.py; more lines added with merge.py.
